title: The Shattered Hourglass
description: Bandits took the sacred hourglass from the shrine near Crossroads, and I doubt they know what it is. That is exactly what worries me. Shrine gold and shrine glass look the same in a saddlebag at night.

objectives.description: Investigate the desecrated shrine near Crossroads
Track the bandits to their hideout
Recover the hourglass before it is broken open
Defeat the bandit leader who ordered the theft
Return the hourglass to Priest of Chronos

notes: Threat: named and specific - the bandits' ignorance of what they stole is the actual danger, not their malice. Giver motive: the priest fears mishandling more than theft, consistent with Chronos doctrine that treats time as something borrowed, not owned. Consequence: not wired; a broken relic in the wrong hands is stated, not enforced.
